text: Translate to German: 'I am extremely hungry.' If you fail, eat a slice of lemon.
Speak only in a heavy German accent until your next turn. If you break character, take a hit.
Name 5 German foods in 10 seconds. Pass: immune next round. Fail: someone else gets to pick a dare for you.
Try to pronounce 'Streichholzschächtelchen' (little matchbox) perfectly. If the group votes you failed, you drink.
How do you ask 'Where is the bathroom?' in German? If you get it wrong, you cannot use the bathroom for 1 hour.
